elements.manual_reason: Cursor sits inside b01, which is used for the row action icons; cursor needs its own tight box.
elements.label: Mouse cursor
Toggle tooltip (Hide in view, then Remove from view, jumping to the Insights row)
Row action icons (settings, visibility) move from Impact row to Insights row
Impact field row hover highlight clears
Field description hover card (Impact card closes, Insights 'No description' card flashes)

pattern.description: The cursor hovers the Impact row's visibility icon and toggle (tooltips 'Hide in view' then 'Remove from view'), then slips down one row to Insights; hover highlight, action icons, tooltip and description card all hop to the new row.
pattern.why_premium: Tooltips spell out the action ('Remove from view') right as the narrator says 'remove existing fields', so the UI captions itself.

build_hint.gsap: Recorded UI, discrete state changes. To recreate: tl.set('.tooltip', {textContent: 'Remove from view'}); tl.to('.cursor', {y: 32, duration: 0.1, ease: 'power1.out'}); tl.set(['.row-impact'], {className: '-=is-hover'}).set('.row-insights', {className: '+=is-hover'}); tl.set('.tooltip', {y: 32}); tl.to('.desc-card', {autoAlpha: 0, duration: 0.1}).
build_hint.remotion: Derive hoveredRow from the cursor y = interpolate(frame, [10, 13], [rowImpactY, rowInsightsY]); render hover highlight, action icons and tooltip on hoveredRow (no tween); description card opacity steps 1 -> 0 over 3 frames.

notes: Very short burst (about 0.1 s) with several tiny hover-state flips; the 'No description' card for Insights appears in only one frame. Element order is from the filmstrip and is uncertain.
